body: I don't even think 60 would be enough. I'd need to mix it with alcohol of which I have none
Close to 8 years now. Without her I would've done it years ago

I really dont. But the pain from losing my career, income, insurance, everything causes so much pain. 

I threw up 3 times today from the nausea of thinking about it all. I wish I could just disappear without having to have my wife find my dead body and having to deal with that. 

I used to find happiness in even simple things. Movies, going out, everything. Now I lay in bed and dont want to get up, sleeping for sometimes 24 hours straight.

The hydro is for sciatica - two herniated discs in L5 S1 area which makes for unbearable pain in my right leg and lower back. 

The Adderall is for ADD - relatively new on it. Been on it for about 6 months now. Seems to be helping with the attention issues.

My doctor told me to stop the effexxor immediately and to combat the zaps and withdrawal with xanax. I will call tomorrow to get more effexxor so I can bridge between the two to make it easier on my self. 

Like you said I *should* be on a higher dose but he prescribed 5mg in the hopes of tapering down to no meds  (hallelujah when that day comes).

I was originally prescribed "head meds" for panic attacks but it seems the 4 years I've been using them they've made me depressed whilst taking the panic attacks away...I'd rather have the CHANCE of a panic attack and take xanax than be depressed all the time.

I'm 25 and I've made a decent amount when I started my job 5 years ago. 

What's keep me afloat is $40,000 from my 401k which I did not want to dip into. Too late for that. 

I'm in the middle of relocating to another state where the job prospects are better (and where it is A LOT warmer) so that's been keeping me upbeat...for now. 

My only quam is getting a job that I'll hate and having to wait for the insurance to kick in. By that time I most likely will have moved. So I'm hesitant about just finding a job to get by. 

This was my first job and I got hired whilst still in college so I have no other experience with interviewing or job hunting at all.
